Uses a hybrid retro directive array payload to characterize the direction of signals from targets of opportunity.  
Description

Built by Auburn University and funded by the Army’s Space and Missile Defense Command, is the newest mission under development in AUSSP. The mission aims to use a hybrid retro directive array (HRA) payload developed at Auburn to characterize the direction of signals from targets of opportunity.
